protocol.multiple_testing_family: all games, methods, pools, thresholds, both periods, both tests
protocol.null: uniform independent draws; fixed pool size conditional on all prior information
protocol.intervals: 95% marginal Clopper-Pearson, not simultaneous; displayed winners are selection-biased
protocol.paired_test: one-sided exact discordant-pair sign test versus frequency; exploratory diagnostic under exchangeable discordances
protocol.same_day: every draw on the target date is excluded from score history
protocol.game_540: six main balls for pool hits; five on a ticket; pool 6-hit does not mean a six-hit ticket
protocol.joker: main urn only; Joker-ball prizes are not modeled
protocol.jackpot_649: For B distinct six-number tickets, P(at least one exact 6)=B/C(49,6) under uniform draws; reordering cannot raise it at fixed B.
protocol.complete_system: Enumerating every pick-sized subset of a fixed pool attains best_ticket_hits=min(pool_hits,pick); no wheel on that pool can exceed this bound.
protocol.pseudomathematical_controls: numeric labels, parity, prime/composite, last-digit and sum-center controls remain offline
